headline: Fivio on Gospel Drill Wave? Akademiks Questions Trend
body: DJ Akademiks posts Instagram story questioning Fivio's role in gospel drill's rise. The post, published September 8, 2026, reads: "Fivio on the gospel drill wave?" with 1,204 likes and 388 comments. Akademiks, a prominent drill music figure, is probing whether Fivio's recent tracks are driving the gospel drill movement. The post sparks debate about the genre's authenticity and commercial viability.
